strength.method: Person-icon HUD counts at 5-second sampling. Two English recognizers must agree on an exact two-digit value with confidence >=0.92 in both, with visible ticket HUD. Ambiguous first-digit 5 readings in the tiny green HUD are withheld for 3-versus-5 review, plus separately logged visual corrections. Missing readings remain null; no smoothing or interpolated flags. Observed runs end on missing or <=33 readings. Selected peaks are visually reviewed; the entire series is not manually verified.

source_recording.layout: 1920x804 normalized to 3440x1440 for legacy HUD coordinates; upsampling adds no detail
source_recording.timing: Sampling-bin offsets corrected: HUD +2.5 seconds, feed +0.25 seconds; within one source frame (0.034 seconds). Result/scoreboard review uses native source timestamps.

feed_method.inclusion: At least 3 distinct source frames and OCR score >=0.80, or 2 source frames with both recognizers agreeing at >=0.92; separate visual reviews.
feed_method.limits: Small compressed source text. Unreadable and isolated single-name rows are not automatically classified. No whole-match accuracy or final-kill claim.
